top_signals.title: Canada’s Transport Overhaul Aims to Boost Trade With Europe, Asia
top_signals.summary: Canada’s need to expand trade with Europe and Asia is a driving force behind a major new package of regulatory and permitting reforms, the country’s transportation minister said.

top_signals.title: Derailed IPO Plans Rattle US Market Ahead of Anthropic Debut
top_signals.summary: A pair of companies delayed their IPOs, sending a ripple of anxiety through the US market as investors wait for Anthropic PBC’s hotly anticipated debut to materialize.
